title: Clopen alpha across the bounded-below inclusion
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a finite commutative ring, $r:T_1\to T_2$ proper, and $j_a:X\hookrightarrow T_a$ quasi-compact open immersions with $j_1r=j_2$. Write $J_a=j_{a!}$, $P_f=Lf^*$ and $\ell_f:P_f\cong D(f^*)$ for the canonical exact-functor comparison. Let $\alpha:P_r\circ J_2\to J_1\circ P_{1_X}$ be the specified unbounded clopen alpha of [lem-sf-proper-open-projection-mate] and $\alpha^+:P_r^+\circ J_2^+\to J_1^+\circ P_{1_X}^+$ the bounded-below alpha of [def-cbc-proetale-clopen-mate-data]. For the canonical inclusion $\iota:D^+\hookrightarrow D$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] and every $K\in D^+(X_{\rm proet},\Lambda)$, $\ell_{r,J_2K}\,\iota(\alpha_K^+)=\alpha_{\iota K}\,J_1(\ell_{1_X,K})$, in Lean composition order, with exact restrictions identified by their canonical inclusion comparisons. This equality is before taking proper-adjunction mates.

source.place: Compactification-independence sentence; canonical bounded-below inclusion calculation in Step 2 of lem-pur-pf-witnessed-mate-normalization; Stacks more-etale.tex, lemma-shriek-proper-and-open, and sites-cohomology.tex, remark-base-change.

proof.text: Normalize cbcClopenAlphaPlus as clopenLocalizedSquarePlus of cbcClopenAlphaSheaf using the exact right-derived base-change factorization. Prove compatibility of localized squares with the inclusion D+ to D by localization uniqueness at Plus.Qh: map the bounded-below factorization through the inclusion and use the standard exact-functor factorization compatibility. Cancel the common target factorization isomorphisms.

Identify cbcClopenAlphaSheaf with AmbientClopen.alpha. Their beta maps are inverses of the same conjugate base-change map and their clopen projectors are definitionally identical. The inverse proEtaleOpenExtensionComp equals the ambient open compositor by uniqueness of left adjoints and left_comp_unique. Their open congruences agree by equality induction and the reflexive uniqueness comparison; their pullback congruences agree by equality induction. Evaluate the words and simplify associators to finish this equality.

Apply ordinary_alpha_localized to the refinement square (j1,identity,r,j2), evaluate at the included bounded-below object, and compose on the right with J1 of the exact comparison for the identity pullback. Cancel its inverse. The localized-square definitions agree, so the preceding two steps give the required unchanged statement.

theorem properOpenRefinementAlpha_plus_inclusion
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ]
    {X T₁ T₂ : Scheme.{u}} (r : T₁ ⟶ T₂) [IsProper r]
    (j₁ : X ⟶ T₁) (j₂ : X ⟶ T₂)
    [IsOpenImmersion j₁] [IsOpenImmersion j₂] [QuasiCompact j₁] [QuasiCompact j₂]
    (h : j₁ ≫ r = j₂)
    (K : DerivedCategory.Plus
      (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))) :
    (leftDerivedUpperStarIsoMapDerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) r).hom.app
        ((openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) j₂).mapDerivedCategory.obj K.obj) ≫
      DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.map
        ((cbcClopenAlphaPlus Λ j₁ j₂ (𝟙 X) r
          (h.trans (Category.id_comp j₂).symm)).app K) =
    (properOpenAlpha Λ j₁ (𝟙 X) r j₂
        (h.trans (Category.id_comp j₂).symm)).app K.obj ≫
      (openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) j₁).mapDerivedCategory.map
        ((leftDerivedUpperStarIsoMapDerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) (𝟙 X)).hom.app
          K.obj)
